quotes.text: You can have the best RFIs, the best submittals, the best everything, but if your plan is shit and no one is aligned, it's very hard to end up on the right track.
Everyone's talking about what's happening with the top hundred companies. And what about the other hundred thousand companies that are building the rest of the country?
There's not going to be an AI that is going to be replacing a superintendent anytime soon, nor a scheduler. Their jobs are just going to evolve.
